documentsRequired: As required on the official portal
title: Voter ID Registration & Other Voter Service 2026
organization: Election Commission of India / NVSP / Voter Portal
postName: New Voter Registration, Correction, EPIC Download, Search Name
vacancyDetails: Form 6 (new voter), Form 8 (correction/migration), EPIC download and electoral roll search
howToApply:
1. Visit https://voters.eci.gov.in
2. Create account / login with mobile
3. Apply Form 6 for new registration or Form 8 for correction
4. Upload photo and documents
5. Download e-EPIC and search name in electoral roll
shortDescription: Voter ID registration, correction, EPIC download and roll search 2026 on voters.eci.gov.in (ECI NVSP).
content:
The Election Commission of India provides online voter services through the Voter Portal / NVSP.

Services

  • New voter registration (Form 6)
  • Correction / shifting of address (Form 8)
  • Download e-EPIC (Voter ID card)
  • Search name in electoral roll

Official portal: voters.eci.gov.in. Minimum age for enrolment is 18 years.
